# Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Barret Zoph, Quoc V. Le  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** ICLR  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1611.01578](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1611.01578)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1611.01578](https://arxiv.org/abs/1611.01578)

**Keywords:** nas, rl

## Abstract

We use a recurrent network to generate the model descriptions of neural networks and train this RNN with reinforcement learning to maximize the expected accuracy.
